description.value: The Cumberland Branch of the Vancouver Island Regional Library has served the community since 1947, now operating from a purpose-built ~3,200 sq. ft. civic building on Dunsmuir Avenue that opened in 2013. Part of the VIRL regional system spanning Vancouver Island and the central BC coast, this public library is a welcoming stop in Cumberland's compact historic downtown. Free public Wi-Fi is available to all visitors without a library card.

bike_parking_detail: 6 racks within 100m: stands (6 spaces, covered) at 7m; stands (2 spaces) at 26m; wall_loops (14 spaces) at 49m; stands (2 spaces) at 63m; rack at 71m; stands (1 space, covered) at 84m. Total: 25 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the branch address (2746 Dunsmuir Avenue) and provides history placing the library in its current ~3,200 sq. ft. civic building since 2013, but contains no explicit mention of bike parking, washrooms, or water refill. OSM tags confirm free public Wi-Fi (internet_access=wlan, internet_access:fee=no, SSID 'VIRL Public Access Point'), which is the only cycling-relevant amenity verifiable from available sources. All other amenity fields default to null as absence of evidence cannot be treated as confirmation.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A public library in Cumberland's downtown core offers free Wi-Fi and a sheltered rest stop for touring cyclists; the location is confirmed open and the listing provides useful directory value even with limited amenity documentation.
